title: Version Baseline Sync v8
description: Daily workflow: fetch latest OneAgent release + ESS oldest supported from docs and store as custom event. Also collects RUM Classic JS library version per app and stores per-app custom events.

compute_versions.description: Fetch latest OneAgent sprint and ESS oldest supported version from Dynatrace docs.
compute_versions.name: compute_versions

store_baseline_event.description: Store OneAgent baseline as a custom annotation event using vault credential and runtime tenant URL.
store_baseline_event.name: store_baseline_event

sync_rum_classic_js_versions.description: Collect RUM Classic JS library versions per app, emit per-app and summary custom annotation events.
sync_rum_classic_js_versions.name: sync_rum_classic_js_versions

guide: Policy semantics in v8: "unsupported" is only assigned when a numeric support floor is explicitly available from configured versions. If no support floor is exposed by the API, versions below target are marked "below_target" (not unsupported).
